rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an artist’s thin brush used to apply paint.

example.english: I use a paintbrush to paint flowers on the canvas.
example.traditional: 我用畫筆喺畫布上畫花。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 waa2 bat1 hai2 waa2 bou3 soeng5 waa2 faa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a brush used to apply paint or varnish to walls, furniture, or other surfaces.

example.english: This paintbrush is for painting doors.
example.traditional: 呢把油掃係用嚟油門㗎。
example.jyutping: ne1 baa2 jau4 sou2 hai6 jung6 lei4 jau4 mun4 gaa3
